description.en: Application of the ESGE SMI risk algorithm to LNPCPs: integrates lesion location, morphology, surface/vascular pattern (NICE/JNET), and bulky features to decide between piecemeal EMR, en bloc resection, and surgical referral.

criteria.en: Recognises bulky/rectal lesions as high-risk for covert SMI with prompting.
Independently applies the SMI risk algorithm and chooses an appropriate resection strategy concordant with expert opinion ≥90% of cases.
Decisions match histology outcomes; teaches the algorithm; manages discordant cases via MDT.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE EMR recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The recommendation is what ESGE publishes; the competency is what Evideris uses to score a trainee on. Not enumerated as objects in Tate EMR 2023; this competency frame is Evideris's design.
